fields.description: LiteLLM model identifier. With a Provider linked, pick or type just the model (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6); otherwise use provider/model form, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, openai/gpt-4.1, ollama/llama3.1. With the Cloudflare provider, use the Workers AI id, e.g. @cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash.
fields.label: Model ID

fields.description: Max input tokens. Detected from the model when empty or when the model changes; type a value to override it. 0 = unknown, a default is used.
fields.label: Context Window

fields.description: API key to authenticate with this model's endpoint. Needed when no Provider is linked.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Endpoint for this model, e.g. a self-hosted Ollama (http://localhost:11434) or a proxy. Needed when no Provider is linked.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Optional JSON object passed to the model (e.g. {"temperature": 0.2, "max_tokens": 1024})
fields.label: Params

fields.description: Who can use this model; empty means every Flow User. Others pick another model for agents that run on it.
fields.label: Roles
